mentions.name: open reader
mentions.description: A local-first PDF text-to-speech reader that highlights words as they are spoken. Built in Python and Qt, it uses the local Kokoro TTS engine and a document-layout LLM so users can skip or include sections like tables and references. It runs offline with no APIs or multiple services, offering fast playback, word-level highlighting, and playback selection.
mentions.problem: Existing web-based readers are slow and clunky; the author was fed up with web tech and wanted a fast, simple local alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: Worked on some features at open reader, a local-first PDF TTS reader that highlights the words spoken and uses the excellent local kokoro tts engine.
